cloudflare_token.note: Fictional planned permissions; no token exists and no actual provider scope has been read.

host_contract.signal: A bounded authenticated and scope-validated signal supplied by a future host; alertText remains externally supplied text.
host_contract.state: A durable transactional storage adapter with Cloudflare DO storage semantics; the host is not wired in this fixture.
host_contract.agent: A provider-neutral single-call interface that honors endpoint, timeout, tool schema, and output token bound; no real SDK or account is configured.
host_contract.transport: Injected fetch-compatible transport; all configured destinations are .example.invalid.
host_contract.records: The adapter stores the last 20 minimal decisions; no customer payloads or raw prompts are recorded.
